assumptions.text: The contemplated product is the principal embodiment as built for Example 1, sold as a removable threaded valve core and possibly as a complete tyre valve; the package does not define the commercial product.
Status of each document is as displayed on its Google Patents page on 2026-09-29; it is not a legal conclusion and must be verified on the registers.
Only the claims saved in prior-art/refs were read; the granted claims of US11338632B2 and the claims of US11808363B1 and US12104701B1 were not read.
No third-party patent is named from memory; patents that the saved search did not find are outside this list.
This list is a drafting and analysis aid; qualified patent counsel decides every question of freedom to operate.

open_questions.text: What is the product to be sold first, a valve core alone or a complete tyre valve with a valve stem, and with which seat ring material?
In which country will the seat ring and the valve core be made, and in which countries will they be sold?
For counsel: commission a professional FTO search covering US, EPC, UK and the country of manufacture, with items 1 to 3 charted first.
For counsel: verify status and family members of US11148485B2, US11179979B2, US11338632B2, US11549591B1, US11808363B1, US12104701B1 and US9611937B2.
For counsel: does [0166], which characterises US11549591B1, need review before filing, given that the same family is an FTO target?
